notes:
- **feat: reconciled transactions filter on Credit Cards tab** — "Unreconciled only / All transactions" select dropdown added to the filter row. Defaults to unreconciled-only so previously reconciled CC charges don't clutter the view; switch to "All transactions" to see full history. Empty-state hint prompts the user to switch when all visible transactions have been reconciled. `jl.is_reconciled` added to `get_credit_card_transactions()` query. (`core/ledger.py`, `web/static/js/credit_cards.js`)

- **fix: `is_bank` flag derived from account_subtype in `save_account()`** — bank accounts with subtype "Bank" or "Cash and Cash Equivalents" now have `is_bank=1` set automatically, matching the existing `is_credit_card` derivation from subtype. Manual flag values remain as fallback for accounts without a recognised subtype. (`core/ledger.py`)
- **feat: bank reconciliation extended to CC and loan accounts** — account selector now queries all account types (previously Asset-only, which silently excluded CC and loan accounts); "Non-Current Liability" added to reconcilable subtypes so loan accounts (e.g. Bank Loan 2-2100) appear in the account picker. Sign conventions corrected for liability accounts: `_brUpdateDiff()` flips journal movement to `credit-debit` and CSV movement to `debit-credit`; `api_bankrec_rec_report` flips `unrgl_net` and `unrbank_net`; `api_bankrec_date_report` flips bank-balance estimates and `outstanding_bank_net`. Asset reconciliation behaviour unchanged. (`web/routes/bankrec.py`, `web/static/js/bankrec.js`)

- **fix: cash flow statement — report now balances** — five root causes corrected. (1) AR/AP working capital used "invoiced vs receipts" approximation that missed direct GL adjustments; replaced with a `_wc_chg()` helper reading the GL account movement directly for all WC items (AR, AP, Inventory, GST Paid). (2) Credit Card excluded from all sections — moved to Financing per AASB 107 (CC is a short-term borrowing, not a trade payable). (3) EOFY year-end close entries included in Retained Earnings' financing movement, double-counting net_profit already in Operating — fixed by filtering `je.reference NOT LIKE 'EOFY-%'` from the financing query. (4) Inventory change read from `inventory_movements` table (qty × cost) which diverged from the GL — replaced with `_wc_chg("1-1400")`. (5) GST Paid (1-1300) increase was uncaptured — added to operating working capital. (`core/ledger.py`)
- **fix: cash flow financing section — BS-driven, no flags required** — financing exclusion list tightened to `('Accounts Payable')` only; all other liabilities (CC, loans, overdrafts, lines of credit) automatically appear in financing by account type without needing a separate flag. (`core/ledger.py`)

- **feat: Petty Cash report** — new report type in Reports module. Opening balance (GL balance before the selected period), disbursements table with date/description/expense account/amount, replenishments table, closing balance. Float selector in opts card. "View Report" button in the reconciliation wizard Step 2 pre-wires float and date range and navigates directly to the report. (`core/petty_cash.py`, `web/routes/petty_cash.py`, `web/static/js/reports.js`)
- **feat: Petty Cash reconciliation wizard** — two-step wizard replaces the count-only modal. Step 1 batch-enters receipts from the tin (date, description, expense account, net amount, GST with 10%-fill button, add/remove rows, running total). Step 2 shows physical count vs GL variance, replenishment form pre-filled with session disbursement total, Print Slips button (printable card-sized vouchers to staple to physical receipts), and View Report shortcut. (`web/static/js/petty_cash.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: Petty Cash module** — new module for float-based cash management. Float selector bar with live balances, date range filter, transaction table with running balance and type badges, disbursement form (det-panel) with GST auto-fill, replenishment form, new float modal. GL: disbursement posts DR Expense + DR GST Paid → CR Petty Cash; replenishment posts DR Petty Cash → CR Bank. Void posts a reversal journal and marks original [VOIDED]. Nav item (💰 Petty Cash) added alongside Credit Cards. (`core/petty_cash.py`, `web/routes/petty_cash.py`, `web/static/js/petty_cash.js`, `web/templates/dashboard.html`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: POS visibility toggle on items list** — "POS" column added to Item Catalogue list showing a clickable In POS / Hidden badge per row; clicking toggles without opening the edit form. Two new filter pills: In POS and Not in POS with counts. Lightweight `PATCH /api/items/<id>/pos-visible` endpoint for single-field update. (`web/static/js/items.js`, `web/routes/inventory.py`, `web/static/dbox.css`)

- **docs: NOTES.md reorganised and archived** — added Action Items, Blocked, and Feature Backlog sections to NOTES.md; consolidated recurring "Next" entries from six sessions into the Action Items table; archived 13 old sessions (2026-05 and 2026-06) and completed static sections (CRM/Jobs Consolidation, Licensing Model, Setup Wizard, FWC Integration, POS Known Gaps, Web UI Roadmap, Development Workflow) to DEVLOG.md. NOTES.md reduced from 1,307 to 458 lines. (`NOTES.md`, `DEVLOG.md`)

- **fix: Tyro terminal pairing — switched to iframe embed** — `_posTyroPair()` now opens a modal containing Tyro's hosted configuration page (`configuration.html#expert`) in an iframe instead of calling the headless `pairTerminal()` API. Iframe approach handles the 90-second terminal lock automatically and is the preferred method per Tyro certification criteria. Settings row simplified: removed now-unused status span and button ID. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **fix: Tyro certification criteria gaps — merchant copy toggle, declined receipts, surcharge line item, settlement confirm** — (1) Merchant copy printing toggle added to settings: when ON prints merchant copy for all transactions; when OFF prints only for signature-required (which is always mandatory). (2) Customer receipt from `transactionCompleteCallback` now sent to thermal printer for DECLINED/CANCELLED/REVERSED transactions when integrated receipts enabled. (3) "Tyro Surcharge" and "Card charged" lines displayed on sale-complete receipt modal when surcharge was applied. (4) Manual settlement now requires user confirmation dialog before `manualSettlement()` fires. Also adds `tyro_merchant_copy` setting column. (`core/pos_settings.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **fix: Tyro sandbox URL corrected, iClient logs fixed, continueLastTransaction added** — (1) Sandbox script URL was `iclienttest.tyro.com`; corrected to `iclientsimulator.test.tyro.com` per official docs. (2) `_posTyroShowLogs()` was calling a non-existent `client.requestClientLogs()` method; replaced with an iframe modal embedding the correct Tyro logs URL. (3) `continueLastTransaction()` added to `pagePos()` for Tyro provider — resumes any transaction interrupted by a browser refresh/close and shows a recovery notice if approved. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Tyro iClient — integrated receipts, surcharging, certification settings** — Three Tyro certification requirements implemented. (1) Integrated receipts: `integratedReceipt` driven by new `tyro_integrated_receipt` setting; `receiptCallback` handles merchant copy (with signature prompt); `td.customerReceipt` shown on sale-complete modal. (2) Integrated surcharging: `enableSurcharge` driven by `tyro_integrated_surcharge` setting; `td.surchargeAmount` (cents) stored in new `pos_sales.tyro_surcharge_cents` column, threaded through split flow, added to refund amount. (3) Settings page additions: Integrated Receipts checkbox, Integrated Surcharging checkbox, and Request iClient Logs button added to Tyro section; `_posTyroShowLogs()` calls `client.requestClientLogs()`. Migration adds `tyro_integrated_receipt`, `tyro_integrated_surcharge` to `pos_settings` and `tyro_surcharge_cents` to `pos_sales`. (`core/pos_settings.py`, `core/pos.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Tyro iClient integration (alternative EFTPOS path)** — Tyro Integrated EFTPOS added as a selectable payment provider alongside Linkly. Uses Headful iClient (`TYRO.IClientWithUI`) — browser-side JS library, no Flask backend for transactions. Covers: purchase, split-tender card charge, card refund, end-of-day settlement, and terminal pairing. Settings: MID, TID, and sandbox toggle stored in `pos_settings` (`tyro_merchant_id`, `tyro_tid`, `tyro_sandbox` columns). iClient script lazy-loaded from Tyro CDN (sandbox: `iclienttest.tyro.com`). All API call sites use correct spec: String cent amounts, `{transactionCompleteCallback}` object callback, `pairTerminal(mid, tid, cb)`, `manualSettlement(cb)`. (`core/pos_settings.py`, `web/static/js/pos.js`)

- **feat: Mailman unread badge in sidebar** — ✉ icon added to sidebar footer; shows red unread-count badge when Dogbox Mailman is running with unread messages; clicking opens Mailman in a new tab; polls on load and every 2 minutes; badge hidden when Mailman is offline or count is zero. (`web/templates/dashboard.html`, `web/routes/contacts.py`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: contact email history tab (Mailman integration)** — "Emails" tab in contact det-panel; fetches last 20 emails from Dogbox Mailman at `localhost:5200/api/ext/emails`; shows subject, date, sender name, Mailman account badge, and snippet; graceful offline message when Mailman is not running. (`web/routes/contacts.py`, `web/static/js/contacts.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **fix: duplicate-submission guards on task complete and schedule modals** — `_jobCompleteTask` now accepts and disables the calling button element; `#jwt-next-sched` (jobs) and `#wt-next-sched` (contacts) disable their button before the fetch to prevent double-clicking creating duplicate recurring tasks. (`web/static/js/jobs.js`, `web/static/js/contacts.js`)
- **fix: bank rec double-allocation creates orphan journal entry** — `allocate_bank_transaction()` and `allocate_bank_transaction_multi()` now raise if `journal_id` is already set, preventing a double-click from posting duplicate journals against the same bank transaction. (`core/ledger.py`)

- **fix: bank rec CSV import — column selects blank on first view of step 2** — preset/auto-map was applied while step 2 was `display:none`; `select.value` on hidden selects doesn't reliably stick. Re-applies selected preset (or auto-map) when step 2 becomes visible. (`web/static/js/bankrec.js`)
- **fix: bank rec CSV import — "auto detect" option did nothing** — `_brApplyPreset('')` returned immediately without re-running auto-map; now calls `_brCsvParseHeaders()` so column sniffing runs on demand. (`web/static/js/bankrec.js`)
- **fix: bank rec CSV import — "Preview →" advanced to step 3 even when date column unmapped** — `_brCsvPreview()` returned early via bare `return` on missing date column; `_brCsvNext` didn't check the result and still transitioned, leaving the user on step 3 with 0 importable rows. Preview now returns `false`; Next guards on it. (`web/static/js/bankrec.js`)
- **fix: bank rec CSV import — stale localStorage preset key left columns blank** — if `dbox-br-last-preset` pointed to a deleted custom preset `_brApplyPreset` silently exited; now clears the stale key and falls back to auto-map. (`web/static/js/bankrec.js`)

- **fix: new work task under a job fails to save** — `_jobSaveNewWorkTask` now passes `contact_id` from the loaded job (`_jobDetail.job.contact_id`) in the POST body; the `/api/work-tasks` endpoint requires it and the job object is already in memory. (`web/static/js/jobs.js`)
- **feat: "No Job" filter on contacts tasks tab** — toggle pill added to the task log toolbar; filters to tasks with no linked job, stacks with existing status filters and date range, included in printed output. (`web/static/js/contacts.js`)
- **feat: "Recurring" filter on contacts tasks tab** — toggle pill filters to recurring tasks only; stacks with all other filters (status, date, No Job); included in print label. (`web/static/js/contacts.js`)
- **feat: Open/Completed/All + Recurring filters on jobs tasks tab** — refactored `_jobTabTasks` into a toolbar + `_jobRefreshTaskRows`; `_jobTaskRow` extracted from local closure; filter state persists across add/complete/delete refreshes. (`web/static/js/jobs.js`)
- **fix: bank rec Import CSV modal stuck on "Importing…" after successful import** — modal bd given id `br-import-modal`; success handler closes by ID instead of `document.querySelector('.modal-bd')` which was not finding the element. (`web/static/js/bankrec.js`)

- **chore: rename launcher `web_server.py` → `dbox.py`** — all references updated across build scripts (`build_linux.sh`, `build_macos.sh`, `build_windows.bat`), install scripts (`dbox.sh`, `macinstall.sh`, `lininstall.sh`, `wininstall.bat`), tools (`tools/build_dist.py`, `tools/build_guides.py`, `tools/stamp_copyright.py`), web layer (`web/routes/system.py`, `web/server.py`), and docs (`CLAUDE.md`, `README.md`). Nuitka rename step removed — output binary is now named correctly without it. (`dbox.py`, build/install scripts)
- **chore: remove Linkly debug print statements** — `[LINKLY REQUEST/RESPONSE]`, `[LINKLY ERROR RESPONSE]`, `[LINKLY REFUND REQUEST/RESPONSE/ERROR]`, and `[LINKLY RECOVERY REQUEST/RESPONSE]` print statements removed from purchase, refund, and recovery flows. (`core/pos.py`)
- **fix: Windows installer auto-installs Python silently** — `wininstall.bat` previously directed users to python.org when Python was not found; now downloads `python-3.13.3-amd64.exe` via PowerShell and installs silently with `PrependPath=1`. No browser redirect required. Release zip rebuilt and pushed. (`wininstall.bat`)
